Steam Engine preserves Xtar IMR 18350 850mAh 5C as a 850mAh preset with a 5C runtime rating.

The Xtar IMR 18350 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Xtar IMR 18350 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2015-05-04 or earlier.
